name: JellyChat
overview: JellyChat drawer for Jellyfin SyncPlay sessions.
description: Adds a JellyChat drawer to Jellyfin web clients for SyncPlay sessions using plugin-owned in-memory history. It does not use Jellyfin toast chat transport, an external WebSocket server, or additional network ports.

versions.changelog: JellyChat v0.1.0 MVP release. Adds a Jellyfin SyncPlay chat drawer backed by plugin-owned in-memory history. Does not use Jellyfin toast chat transport, an external WebSocket server, or new ports. Tested with Jellyfin 10.11.x. Built against Jellyfin.Controller / Jellyfin.Model 10.11.8. Target ABI: 10.11.0.0.
